newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Impexmetal to buy aluminium plant stake.
newsitem.headline: Polish Impexmetal to buy aluminium plant stake.

text.p: Polish metals trader Impexmetal SA on Tuesday signed an agreement with the state treasury on buying a 75 percent stake in aluminium plant Zaklady Metalurgiczne Skawina SA for 22.5 million zlotys, PAP news agency said.

"The deputy treasury minister Leszek Juchniewicz signed an agreement on Tuesday on selling 75 percent of shares in Zaklady Metalurgiczne Skawina to holding Impexmetal SA," PAP quoted Impexmetal's spokesman Marek Hauszyld as saying. @

The remaining 20 percent in Skawina, Poland's second largest aluminium plant, were earmarked for the firm's employees and five percent for a government programme of compensating former owners for property confiscated under the communist rule.
Impexmetal and treasury ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
Salomon Brothers in London earlier said the state-owned Impexmetal, slated for bourse listing in mid-1997, was worth about $40 million.
